description: One place to put Bitcoin to work on Stacks. YieldNexus brings sBTC yield strategies into a single dashboard, with a simple path for beginners and full detail for experienced users, on top of a yield-manager contract.
role: Front-end engineer: designed and built the web app; a teammate wrote the contracts
contributions: Built a product-requirements site that set out the scope before the app
Designed and built the web app in Next.js and TypeScript: landing page, how it works, and the user dashboard
Built the dashboard: portfolio overview, notifications and profile
Connected Stacks wallets with Stacks Connect
results: From requirements to a working dashboard in five weeks

body.heading: The problem
paragraphs: Earning yield on Bitcoin through Stacks means visiting several protocols, each with its own interface and its own risks. A newcomer doesn't know where to start; an experienced user has to piece their position together by hand.

body.heading: What I built
paragraphs: I wrote the product requirements, then designed and built the web app: a landing page that explains sBTC yield in plain terms, and a dashboard showing the user's position, notifications and profile, connected to Stacks wallets. The yield-manager contract and its strategies were written by my teammate Emmanuel.

body.heading: Built with
paragraphs: Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind, with Stacks Connect for wallets, on top of a Clarity yield-manager contract.
